CustomField.description: Reference to an Account whose Id (customerId) and AccountNumber, or Name when AccountNumber is blank (customerCode), are used as the customer identity sent to tax engines instead of this Order's billing Account. Tax-calculation only — does not affect invoice ownership, billing address, or any other billing logic. Overrides the Account-level TaxationAccount when set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When set, the referenced Account's Id (customerId) and AccountNumber, or Name when AccountNumber is blank (customerCode), are used as the customer identity sent to tax engines for this Order. Overrides the Quote and Account level.
CustomField.label: Taxation Account
